title: Flowers and views
text: Loved this walk for the views and flowers
author: 875roba

title: Beautiful nature, wonderful hiking route!
text: Beautiful hiking trail, nice variety of a beautiful gorge, rivers, waterfalls, rope bridge, virtually everything unpaved. Beautiful views, views, varied nature with in this part of the year plenty of greenery with delicious scents. Enjoyed it a lot. With a good basic condition, good shoes and a little perseverance just doable!
author: Ellen Z

title: Beautiful and tranquil
text:
Really lovely walk through the tranquil countryside. The walk is not challenging, but sturdy footwear is needed as the paths have loose stones and are used 
neven in places. It’s worth doing this early in the morning to enjoy the views with fewer people on the trail.
author: Sally_H

title: Enjoyable hike in the countryside.
text: Julio was very helpful in arranging an easy pick up point in Granada.  We were the only two in the group (April 2022) but Julio is very easy to chat with so a relaxed experience.  Our hike was about a 30 minute drive from town and it was lovely to see the countryside and be out in nature.  The hike itself was a good mix of walking and climbing but not too taxing.  Would highly recommend.
author: Evelyn_D

title: Route that goes from least to most.
text:
First of two mountain excursions I did in Granada, and first joy.

I must say that I am an absolute stranger about hiking trails, but I love nature and that is why I decided to do it.

The road starts flat along the river, but pulling at the end there is an uphill stretch that would be somewhat demanding for a very sedentary person.

I don’t give more details because these experiences must be lived with the five senses.

In this adventure I shared the experience with two lovely families and with Julio, our guide, who was very close and friendly with all of us and who is rating the experience h
author: Odin_Artemisa

title: Excellent! Beautiful tour!
text:
I joined this tour at the end of February. We were a small group and hit it off right away. It was all there, blooming almond trees, a suspension bridge in a rocky gorge and again and again the river we followed through mountain and valley. 
Also great that photos were taken. Thanks to the tour guide!  
Good job !!! 
Always happy ;)
author: TrailBlazer231661

title: A Trip not to be missed, especially as a Family
text:
A wonderful Experience for our Family, and also perfect for Couples or individuals
Julio was a wonderful Tour Guide, experienced, knowledgable and caring
We were collected by Julio at a central location in Granada and brought to the tour starting point. It was a 30 minute drive.
Julio was very professional with all preparations and with our individual needs.
The hike was conducted at a pace that suited us. With children on board that was very considerate and much appreciated.
The views and vantage points were fabulous.
Julio made a point of taking group and individual photographs along the way
author: dam0000

title: We love walking so we thought this was ideal for us, and we were right
text: My and my girlfriend really enjoyed it, with the hot weather, the walk was not too long. We really loved the vieuws. The guide, Julio, was a friendly guy who gave us a lot of information about a kind of things.

author: maryanbedmar

title: Excellent hiking experience
text: Julio moved us to the place of the beginning of the tour at the indicated time and place. Always with great respect and professionalism the group has guided us and explained what we were meeting along the way and also giving us hiking tips. I in particular had never used the canes. In addition to that he offered to take pictures with our mobile phones as well as with his professional camera and then send us the photos. Returning to the city of Granada, he recommended places for lunch. Fully recommended! It's been a pleasure!
author: nbabu87
